name: Epic Systems
description: Epic Systems Corporation is an American privately held healthcare software company based in Verona, Wisconsin. It develops large-scale software systems for electronic health records.

name: Athenahealth
description: Athenahealth is an American company that provides cloud-based SaaS healthcare technology and network-enabled services for healthcare organizations in the United States, including electronic health records, practice management, and patient engagement tools. [1, 3, 21, 36]

name: Cerner
description: Oracle Health, formerly Cerner, is an American multinational provider of health information technology platforms and services. It offers a comprehensive suite of cloud-based solutions for providers, payers, and public health organizations, including Electronic Health Records (EHR) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, with AI embedded in its technology to streamline operations and enhance care. [3, 41, 42, 44]

name: eClinicalWorks
description: eClinicalWorks is a privately held leader in healthcare IT, providing comprehensive cloud-based Electronic Health Record (EHR) and Practice Management solutions. They serve over 850,000 medical professionals globally with solutions for clinical documentation, telehealth, patient engagement, and revenue cycle management.

name: Filevine

name: Adobe Sign

name: LionDesk

name: BoomTown

name: kvCORE
description: kvCORE is an all-in-one, high-powered real estate website, and CRM solution designed to streamline real estate agents' marketing and client management efforts. It operates as a software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider of cloud-based marketing software for residential real estate agents and brokers to source, convert, and manage their customers. [1, 26]

name: Redfin
description: Redfin is a technology-powered real estate company that provides real estate agent services for buying, selling, and renting homes in the United States and Canada. They offer brokerage, rentals, lending, title insurance, and renovation services, operating the country's #1 real estate brokerage site.

name: BambooHR

name: Rippling

name: ADP
